Usage: tokenzero exact-recovery-audit [OPTIONS]

Options:

Execute JS-like plans that compose the same TokenZero operations as MCP (zero.read, zero.find, zero.shell, ...) in one call for faster multi-step workflows.

Tier B shell trampoline (universal execution): one shell line runs a full plan. Pass the plan inline, via --plan-file, via --stdin / PLAN=-, or pipe a heredoc when stdin is not a TTY. Emits the same tokenzero.codemode.v1 envelope and tz:// refs as the MCP path. Cap harness-visible output with --budget / --max-visible-tokens. Failures are typed (status=error + error.kind); no silent partials.
